name: GET /api/leadflow/sequences/guards/log - Why steps were deferred or refused
description: The last 200 guard decisions - quiet hours, consent, suppression, stop rules - alongside the circuit breakers and whether each is currently open. THE BREAKER IS VISIBLE RATHER THAN ONLY EFFECTIVE, which is the reason this endpoint exists: an invisible breaker looks exactly like a cadence that quietly stopped working, and the two are investigated completely differently. `open` is computed from opened_at together with retry_after rather than stored, so a breaker whose retry window has elapsed reads as closed without anything having to write to it. QA: depends on register and login for the bearer token.

testCases.name: The guard log answers with its entries and the breaker state
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all

errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, or present without a bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
